target_findings.explanation: At freezeAccount(address,bool), the checked privileged change restricts the outgoing right of the designated holder for an otherwise usable request within the recorded domain.

The assessment concerns a restriction on the designated holder's outgoing transfer at source offset 1615 under management_role. The scoped controller change prevents the same positive outgoing use for ordinary holders without an applicable exempt agent. A committing use and its control direction were checked on the actual ledger.

At distributeReward(address,address,address), the checked privilege permits positive additional rights for the controller or a beneficiary it can select. A balance increase for an independent ordinary buyer alone does not satisfy this condition.

At burnFrom(address,uint256), the checked privilege permits positive additional rights for the controller or a beneficiary it can select. The intervention can enable a new same-request outcome; baseline commitment is not established.
